description: Default format: S+D rows, triggers, forbid/require/prefer/inform, 20/30 word budgets
S-only (no D rows): 81.2% savings, halved token count
S-only + no triggers: 85.4% savings
MUST/MUST_NOT/SHOULD/INFO effect vocab (RFC 2119 style): 85.2% savings
GOVERNANCE header + 'rule' column name: +1 token vs exp03, no benefit
PROJECT_RULES header: +1 token vs exp03, no benefit
Drop level+trigger columns (S-only, 3 columns): 86.4% savings
15-word budget: no change (descriptions already <10 words)
10-word budget: no change (descriptions already <10 words)
Group by severity (critical first): same tokens, primacy bias benefit
Add severity column: +22 tokens, redundant with effect (MUST_NOT=high/critical)
Row separator (---): +9 tokens, adds noise in S-only format
Preamble 'Comply with ALL rules below. Violations are failures.': +12 tokens, compliance priming
Shorter preamble 'STRICT: follow every rule.': +7 tokens vs no-preamble
Violation example column: +84 tokens but shows LLM exact patterns to avoid
Examples only (no preamble): 240 tokens, examples cost +77 over minimal
Trigger+example columns: header/data mismatch, triggers shorter than examples
2-column (id,instruction) with embedded effect prefix: 162 tokens, most compact readable format
Numbered list format: +9 tokens vs TOON 2-col, loses schema context from header
2-col + trigger column: +61 tokens, triggers overlap with instruction text
S+D with examples: 380 tokens, redundant (examples in both S and D rows)
Lowercase effect vocab (forbid/require/prefer): 160 tokens, -2 vs MUST_NOT
NEVER/ALWAYS/SHOULD vocab: 165 tokens, 'NEVER: Never use...' redundancy, semantic mismatch on require rules
Remove count from header (RULES{id,instruction}:): 159 tokens, count derivable from rows
No schema header (RULES: only): 154 tokens min, but LLM loses column semantics
Pipe separator in header: header/data separator mismatch, -1 token marginal
D-rows only for critical/high: 256 tokens, D rows just repeat instruction
